error[ZBX-E0504]: the registry's certificate can't be trusted
  while  resolving registry.test/fixture/open:3.20
  cause  the certificate of registry.test does not lead to a root this machine
         trusts
  host   registry.test
  fix    behind a proxy that inspects traffic, trust its certificate authority
         in the system store, or in a file that SSL_CERT_FILE names
  more   zbx explain E0504
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0504.html
